text = 'namespace = main, params = config, filename = example.txt'

match = re.search(pattern, text)

if match:
    # Accessing named groups by their names
    namespace = match.group('namespace')
    params = match.group('params')
    filename = match.group('filename')
    
    # Print the results
    print(f'Namespace: {namespace}, Params: {params}, Filename: {filename}')
else:

This code uses named groups in the regular expression pattern to make it more readable and maintainable. local function getEntityStatements(entity, propertyId, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    local statements = entity.claims[propertyId]

    if propertyId and statements then
        local originalStatements = mw.clone(statements)

        for _, statement in ipairs(statements) do
            if qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled then
                statement["qualifiers"] = nil
                statement["references"] = nil
            end
        end

        local cloneOfStatements = mw.clone(statements)

        if qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled then
            for cloneKey, cloneOfStatement in ipairs(cloneOfStatements) do
                cloneOfStatement["qualifiers"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["qualifiers"]
                cloneOfStatement["references"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["references"]
            end
        end

        return cloneOfStatements
    end

    return statements
end

local function updateStatementTable(actualStatementTable, key, value, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    local statements = getEntityStatements(actualStatementTable, key, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    if statements then
        actualStatementTable[key] = value -- update original table
    end
end
